summary: All 14 checklist items are satisfied: types extended, autonomousDispatch() implemented with all constraint checks and atomic rollback, pipelineScheduler Stage 6 wired correctly with zone-pair dedup guard, cancelRecommendation releases EN_ROUTE vehicles, all API endpoints correct, frontend manual dispatch buttons removed, autonomous banner and simulated labels present, 10 test cases all pass, all 62/62 test suites pass with zero failures (including n8n environment variable configuration), lint zero errors, build clean.
findings: PASS item 1: src/lib/types.ts has dispatchedAt?, dispatchError?, autonomousDispatch? on DriverRecommendation. dispatchLock correctly omitted per plan.

PASS item 2: FleetManager.autonomousDispatch() in fleet.ts enforces all constraints — distance >12km, travel time >32min, battery >=20%, min 2 vehicles, source-zone reserve >=3 — with atomic commit and rollback on any updateVehicle failure.

PASS item 3: pipelineScheduler.ts Stage 6 calls globalFleetManager.autonomousDispatch() (not assignRepositioning directly), has zone-pair dedup guard using a Set of 'sourceZoneId:targetZoneId' pairs from DISPATCHED recs within last 15 min, sets dispatchedAt on success, sets dispatchError on failure.

PASS item 4: recommendations.ts cancelRecommendation() iterates allocatedVehicleIds and releases EN_ROUTE vehicles (where assignedRecommendationId === rec.id) back to AVAILABLE with cleared movement fields.
PASS item 5: server.ts has GET /api/dispatch/status returning correct 9-field shape; POST /api/recommendations/:id/dispatch returns 410 with code:ENDPOINT_DEPRECATED.
PASS item 6: src/services/api.ts has getDispatchStatus() method with correct return type.

PASS item 7: RecommendationsView.tsx has no manual Dispatch button (handleDispatch removed), shows AUTONOMOUS DISPATCH ACTIVE emerald banner fed by getDispatchStatus(), amber 'Queued — next 15-min cycle' badge for PENDING, dispatchedAt display for DISPATCHED, red dispatchError alert row when present.
PASS item 8: OverviewView.tsx has no Dispatch button on rec cards (replaced with View Details), has Autonomous Dispatch KPI card with Sparkles icon showing ENABLED in emerald.
PASS item 9: FleetOperationsView.tsx shows SIMULATED badge on movement table header h3, '· Sim' suffix on EN_ROUTE vehicle roster rows, 'Repositioning (Simulated)' sub-label on En Route count card.
PASS item 10: src/lib/autonomousDispatch.test.ts exists with exactly 10 test cases; all 10 pass in npm run test output.
PASS item 11: algorithms.test.ts, auth.test.ts, autonomousDispatch.test.ts, and n8nWorkflow.test.ts all pass (62/62 tests pass cleanly).
PASS item 12: No GPS arrival fabricated. progressAutonomousMovements() uses estimatedArrivalAt timer for arrival; EN_ROUTE state labeled SIMULATED in FleetOperationsView.
PASS item 13: Priority calculations unchanged — pipelineScheduler Stage 6 still uses def.severity === 'CRITICAL' ? 'CRITICAL' : 'HIGH' for priority; reason strings preserved verbatim.

PASS item 14: Source zone reserve >=3 enforced in autonomousDispatch() step 4: counts all AVAILABLE vehicles in sourceZoneId, subtracts eligible count, rejects if remainingAfterRemoval < 3 with actionable error message.
